display.title: Open the Iridescent Codex
display.subtitle: Your in-game guide to the pack
description: The Iridescent Codex is your reference for every pack system — progression,
the four lanes, dimensions, bosses, and gear.
You are handed one when you first join. Hold it and right-click to open it,
then skim the Welcome chapter (Intro, First Hour, Keybinds) before you set out.
